Datasets

ImageNet expands the data frontier

A large, organized image database created new opportunities for visual recognition research.

Jia Deng and colleagues

The contribution

ImageNet organized images using a semantic hierarchy and supplied labeled examples at a scale intended to support broad object recognition. The paper established the database as research infrastructure, distinct from the later annual challenge.

What this does not establish

A dataset is not a model. Benchmark performance measures performance under a particular dataset and evaluation protocol.

Why this date?

The database paper appeared at CVPR 2009. This is distinct from later ImageNet challenge results.

This entry follows the linked publication. Read the source and date conventions.
